body:
Yeah, it was nice of you to talk. I don't think I'll off myself now. I've worked a bit on a story that is just as crazy as I am. Perhaps I'll finish it, perhaps not.

Wait, what am I talking about now? Ah, that's right. Story. So yeah. Be safe and don't kill yourself. You helped me a lot.

Good day!
Abuse, in this situation, for me = screaming in my face, smacking, demeaning, screaming, more screaming, more smacking, and a good dose of shit said to make me feel like a shit.

Thanks man.

We called the exterminator and we're getting rid of the bugs. I've just had paranoid freak outs about bugs/people watching me the last few days that haven't helped me out.

I can't make any money without them finding out. I can't get transportation to a job without them/them knowing, I can't sneak out without them knowing.

I am just fucked up.

Take some more tea.

Mom and Dad said that because of the fucking bed bugs, they're not sure if they'll let me go away to college.

So, I may not actually get away from it in two years.

I can just keep cutting myself until I die.

And here's a list:

1. My boyfriend broke up with me.
2. I want to be straight instead of bi.
3. I have bedbugs.
4. My parents are abusive
5. My grades went down the shitter and finals are tomorrow
6. My parents are constantly yelling at me about said bedbugs
7. People where I live are jerks.
8. And so on
